expected: The operation is eligible to insert in batches of two and one rather than executing one statement per row; the example does not establish a commit boundary.

input: Select a native SQLite target instead, leaving the table otherwise eligible for Insert All.
expected: The manual marks native SQLite No for bulk transfer; no particular rejection or fallback is specified by the table.

input: Add a procedure ListBerths() with a declared fixed resultset containing berth code A2. Select Show Nodes as Source and wire the code to the output.
expected: The source exposes A2 without a mapped argument; the result is a procedure recordset rather than an authored SELECT component.

locator: right side contains the return and the output parameters
input: Wire a required berth prefix to Insert Call with Parameters for a procedure with a known fixed resultset and declared scalar OUT count. Supply A then B in separate cases.
expected: The corresponding resultset and OUT count can both be mapped from the call. Required arguments must be supplied even if the server declaration gives them defaults.

locator: executed before the procedure is called
input: Map a berth identifier into Show Nodes as Target. Set an optional setup statement and enable transactions; no normal result consumer is attached.
expected: Actual execution runs the setup statement before the target procedure and can roll back the transaction on error. Preview pseudo-SQL is not execution.

locator: key and inserting the record occur during the same transaction
input: A target procedure returns a generated berth key in an OUT parameter. Define a local relation from that parameter to the child table, and enable procedure transactions.
expected: The dependent insert uses the generated key in the same transaction. The target parameter is shown for the relation, not exposed as a normal call output wire.

input: Under a valid parent, one child insert succeeds and the next violates a required-column constraint. Enable current-transaction-and-continue only on the child.
expected: Only the faulty child is rolled back and processing continues; the sibling and parent are not undone by this error.

locator: rolled back together with the other two Book records
input: Use the same parent and child failure, now with rollback enabled on the parent and top-transaction-and-continue on the child.
expected: Roll back the faulty child, its sibling and the parent in the enabled top transaction, then process the next parent.

input: In BUILT-IN, set component tracing to Always and inherit it on a wired target with a successful Insert All. Exclude one field from tracing.
expected: The XML trace describes the target action and its affected row count, without the excluded field. A generic run report is not this XML trace.

locator: not possible to use full tracing at table and stored-procedure level
input: Set component tracing to Error and have the table inherit those settings. Include a successful action and a failing action.
expected: The parent level prevents full tracing; expect the failure, not a full successful-action report. Error code, state and text depend on the driver.
